weekly_theme.summary: 這段期間沒有特別重大的星象事件，是適合按自己步調安排生活的一週。

aries.horoscope: 今天，白羊座，你會發現與親密的朋友和浪漫的伴侶聯繫會給你帶來巨大的回報，因為你感覺特別適應周圍的人。期待快樂的時刻，特別是如果孩子們參與其中。您的創造力正處於高峯期，是開始新事業的理想時機。讓你的熱情和積極的態度驅使你走向令人興奮的成就。玩得開心！
aries.horoscope_en: Today, Aries, you'll find that connecting with your close friends and romantic partner brings you great rewards, as you're feeling particularly attuned to those around you. Expect moments of joy, especially if children are involved. Your creative energy is at a peak, making it an ideal time to embark on new ventures. Let your enthusiasm and positive outlook drive you toward exciting accomplishments. Have fun!

taurus.horoscope: 你最近的成就可能會引發新的雄心壯志，旨在提升你的財務和社會地位。對未來的事情有強烈的決心和信心，可能會讓你心滿意足。你的策略已被證明是有效的，隨著你的直覺增強，你正在經歷與家人的深刻聯繫，讓你了解他們的想法和情緒。您的職業生涯和個人關係都在上升軌道上。 擁抱正能量！
taurus.horoscope_en: Your recent achievements may spark new ambitions aimed at elevating your financial and social status. A strong sense of determination and confidence about what lies ahead is likely to fill you. Your strategies have proven effective, and you're experiencing a deep connection with your family, as your intuition is heightened, allowing you to pick up on their thoughts and emotions. Both your professional life and personal relationships are on an upward trajectory. Embrace this positive energy!

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，你通常以理性和分析的心態處理情況，但今天你可能會發現你的直覺以意想不到的方式領先。你的溝通能力可能超越單純的言語，揭示更深層的意義。你可能會從周圍環境中感受到樂觀情緒、熱情和靈感。繼續前進！
gemini.horoscope_en: Typically, you approach situations with a rational and analytical mindset, Gemini, but today you might find your intuition taking the lead in unexpected ways. Your ability to communicate may transcend mere words, revealing deeper meanings. You’re likely to feel a surge of optimism, enthusiasm, and inspiration from your surroundings. Keep moving forward on your journey!

cancer.horoscope: 由於靈感源源不絕，你的創意能力如今得到提升。你可能會發現自己將一天的很大一部分時間用於將自己的想法轉化為有形的創作。雖然你的直覺總是強烈的，但今天它特別敏銳，所以請密切關注你所獲得的任何見解。請務必將它們記下來，因為它們稍後可能會很有價值。 將筆記本和筆放在牀邊，以捕捉夜間可能出現的任何想法或夢想。
cancer.horoscope_en: Your creative abilities are heightened today, fueled by a surge of profound inspiration. You might find yourself dedicating a significant portion of your day to transforming your thoughts into tangible creations. While your intuition is always strong, today it’s particularly sharp, so pay close attention to any insights that come your way. Make sure to jot them down, as they could be valuable later. Keep a notebook and pen by your bedside to capture any ideas or dreams that may arise during the night.

leo.horoscope: 你正進入一個充滿樂觀和崇高夢想的階段，獅子座。靈性的相遇可以將你的靈提升到新的高度。你現在的直覺特別敏銳。你可能會發現自己正在考慮前往遙遠的地方或外國的旅程，特別是與豐富的靈性遺產有關的旅程。但是，明智的做法是在確定任何計劃之前，先推遲一兩天，並與朋友討論您的想法。
leo.horoscope_en: You're entering a phase filled with optimism and lofty dreams, Leo. Spiritual encounters could elevate your spirits to new heights. Your intuition is particularly sharp right now. You might find yourself contemplating a journey to a far-off place or a foreign land, especially one tied to a rich spiritual heritage. However, it's wise to hold off for a day or two and discuss your ideas with friends before finalizing any plans.

virgo.horoscope_en: In this period, your intuition is heightened, and a wave of optimism sweeps over you, Virgo. You may find yourself bursting with artistic inspiration, allowing you to infuse your recent endeavors with fresh insights. Your connections with others are likely thriving, as your deeper comprehension of their needs encourages you to offer support and compassion. Embrace the positivity of the day!

libra.horoscope_en: Today, any online gatherings you participate in are likely to have a spiritual focus, like group meditations. You might connect with new friends from distant locations who resonate with your passions. While you typically lean towards intellectual pursuits, your intuition is heightened today. Be sure to jot down your thoughts and inspirations so you don’t lose track of them; they could prove valuable later on.

scorpio.horoscope: 你可能會發現一些明亮而富有想像力的夢想為即將到來的創意事業帶來了靈感。你目前的心情是快樂和積極的，這種令人振奮的能量將持續存在。跡象表明你的職業生涯和個人關係都取得了成就。你增強的直覺將加深你對周圍人的洞察力。期待朋友和同事尋求您的建議和鼓勵。
scorpio.horoscope_en: You may find that some bright and imaginative dreams spark ideas for upcoming creative endeavors. Your current mood is one of joy and positivity, and this uplifting energy is set to persist. Signs point to achievements in both your professional life and personal connections. Your heightened intuition will deepen your insight into those around you. Expect friends and coworkers to seek your advice and encouragement.

sagittarius.horoscope: 今天，你的思緒可能會徘徊在一個當之無愧的度假地點。在過去幾個月付出這麼多努力後，渴望休息一段時間是很自然的。今年，你可能會傾向於探索未知的領域，也許會冒險前往一片豐富靈性傳承的遙遠土地。期待與親人建立更深層次的聯繫，並對未來充滿希望。擁抱正能量！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Today, your mind may wander to the idea of a well-deserved getaway. After putting in so much effort over the past few months, it's only natural to crave some time off. This year, you might be inclined to explore uncharted territories, perhaps venturing to a distant land rich in spiritual heritage. Expect to feel a deeper connection with your loved ones and a sense of hope for what lies ahead. Embrace this positive energy!

capricorn.horoscope_en: Today, Capricorn, you should find yourself in excellent health. You'll likely experience a surge of physical, emotional, and spiritual vitality, empowering you to connect with your inner strength. Your dreams might offer a pathway to let go of past traumas and embrace new beginnings. A deeper awareness of what others need and want will enhance your connections. Draw inspiration from your previous achievements, keep moving forward, and savor the day ahead.

aquarius.horoscope_en: Your interpersonal skills are on point today, so make the most of them! Your intuition is heightened, allowing you to effortlessly grasp the thoughts and emotions of those around you. Sharing your wisdom and insights will draw people nearer, creating valuable connections. Keep an eye out for social gatherings, as they could lead to exciting new friendships!

pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, your natural ability to read others and understand their emotions is heightened by a surge of intuition. You may find yourself brimming with enthusiasm and a positive outlook. Both your professional and personal life appear to be thriving. On a physical level, you should feel energetic and robust, while your spiritual strength is also at a peak. Make the most of this wonderful day!
